extension.summary: Smooth Prime: Prime Video in the Aurora Cinema interface
extension.description: Smooth Prime is maintained by AgreeWithScotty. Native sign-in, account storage and authentication use independent Smooth Prime implementations. Remaining catalog/network/playback compatibility code is derived from Sandmann79/xbmc under GPL-3.0-or-later; see NOTICE.md. Not affiliated with Amazon.
extension.disclaimer: Uses your own Amazon account. Playback uses this add-on's existing player path and Kodi inputstream. Not affiliated with Amazon.
extension.news: 0.2.20[CR]- Remove the retained login.py and users.py implementations and all their imports/call sites.[CR]- Use independent native account runtime, repository, region discovery, credential selection and token renewal.[CR]- Handle existing-session verification with the native sign-in engine; remove MechanicalSoup/MFA/CAPTCHA fallback UI.[CR]- Read website credentials only from the scoped canonical session; background traffic never starts a password login.[CR]- Guard account/token writes against sign-out, serialize authorization, and record structured real-request diagnostics.[CR]- Remove raw authentication-page HTTP dumps and obsolete packaged validation reports.[CR]- Preserve In Progress, Prime sections, title/episode navigation, stock Kodi playback controls and card return.[CR]- Other catalog/network/playback compatibility code still awaits independent replacement.

extension.description: Delivers updates for the standalone Prime Scene add-on. The index is now hosted by ScottyWins.
